resources.string: On your paired phone, open Gym-Lift → Settings → Watch. Approve this watch to share workouts and calendar. This screen does not grant consent.
Live phone data unavailable. Connect and open Gym-Lift to sync.
Starts on your phone. Keep Gym-Lift open; the request expires after 10 seconds.
No phone plans available. Create a plan on your phone.
A workout is already active on your phone.
Choose where the timer runs. These timers are independent.
Controls the phone timer only. No automatic watch-only fallback.
Runs on this watch only, even when unlinked. It does not change your phone timer.
After restart: restored the saved absolute deadline, not the original duration. An expired timer is cleared without a late alert.
Timer cleared: the saved deadline could not be verified.
Timer could not be saved or scheduled. Reopen this screen to check its state.
Precise alarms are not allowed. Screen-off alerts are best-effort and may be delayed.
Precise alarm permission granted. System settings can still limit alerts.
Notifications are off. A notification is not guaranteed; vibration follows watch system settings.
Notifications enabled. Sound and vibration follow watch settings.
Permission settings could not be opened. Change them in watch system Settings → Apps → Gym-Lift.
No recent or upcoming dates shared by your phone.
Remove phone workout and calendar data from this watch and block this consent generation. Your watch-only timer keeps running. The phone will be notified when connected.
Unlink could not be saved. Try again; phone data remains hidden on this screen.
Phone actions need a current connection and approved link.
Phone queued the request. Open Gym-Lift within the original 10 seconds; otherwise it expires.
No confirmation before expiry. Do not assume the action happened. Check the phone before trying again.
Request expired or the phone state changed. Check the phone and try again.
Phone rejected the request. Check the workout, timer, connection and phone clock.
Outcome unknown. Check the phone before trying again; no watch timer was started.
Cannot send: fresh phone data and an approved connection are required.
This cancels the watch-only alarm. The phone timer is unchanged.
Cannot start: finish or sync your earlier workouts first.
Saved plans expired. Connect your phone to refresh them.
Workout log is full. Finish the workout.
Saved workout data cannot be read. Nothing was changed.
Could not save on the watch. Your last tap was not recorded.
Needs review. Workout kept on this watch.
Needs review on phone. Open Gym-Lift.
Phone received your sets. History is saved after you finish.
Saved on watch. Waiting for phone.
Saved on watch. Some sets still wait for the phone.
Phone has it, but history is not saved yet. Open Gym-Lift on the phone.
Finished on watch. Waiting for phone.
No saved plans yet. Keep the phone linked and open Gym-Lift once.
Saved plans start here even without your phone. Your phone reviews the workout when it reconnects.
Only some plans fit on the watch.
Started offline. Provisional until the phone accepts it.
Discard sent; waiting for the phone to confirm.
Saves it on this watch and sends it to your phone. It counts in history only after the phone imports it.
Deletes the sets logged for this workout. This cannot be undone.
Your work is kept on this watch until the phone accepts it.
Messages need a connected phone and permission in Gym-Lift on the phone.
Short online replies. Chats are shown only while connected and are never stored on the watch.
Replies to this chat are not available from the watch.
Send “%1$s” to %2$s? It is sent once and never retried automatically.
Reply was not sent. Nothing was delivered.
Reply status unknown. Check the chat on your phone before sending again. It is never resent automatically.
Workouts not yet saved on the phone: %1$d. They will be removed from this watch.
